title: The Essence Moths
text: Moths that drink essence swarm above a hidden pool, thousands of them, their wings dusted pale and glowing like ash on embers. The pool beneath them shines. When one strays too close to the water it drinks until it bursts, quietly, in a puff of light.

options.label: Net the glowing moths, and take the essence they have drunk.

outcomes.text: Their wings, heavy with essence, beat softly against the net until they stop. It feels like a small cruelty.

options.label: The hardiest drinks from the pool before the moths do, hungry for its light.

outcomes.text: The light burns bright and strong inside them. Behind it comes a hunger like the moths', which does not go away.

options.label: Leave them their pool. They have so little else.

outcomes.text: For a while they follow you in a pale, glowing cloud. Nothing comes near.
